Pixel polish verification, 2026-10-26
Scope: #98, #127 (expanded to torch, guide trail and Beacon), #84 and #85.

Automated checks
- pixel-particles.check.ts: historical spawn positions survive a turn, pause stops
  the cosmetic clock, teleport clears old trail, extinguish clears torch sparks,
  fixed 256-slot recycling, quality count reduction and new-run reset.
- cave-detail.check.ts: all 19 supplied detail names reachable; deterministic
  choices, sparse density, exclusion from one-tile corridors, 4 damage stages.
- Existing shadow-mist checks retain per-kind/state/density/cap/read-only proof.
- Existing crack, cave-hash and rock-route checks remain required.
- Asset gate now checks every detail name against the delivered atlas.

Browser verification (headless Edge, 1280x800)
- Plant/large-resin draw coordinates match at 4 times: 8 recorded draws.
- 41 black shadow squares from 3 enemy kinds; every fill is #000000, alpha 1,
  with integer position and size; no circles/blur used by the shadow painter.
- Continuous emission recorded 14 torch, 31 guide and 21 Beacon particles.
  Extinguishing removes source-0 particles immediately. Old guide particles
  retain the first leg after a right-angle turn instead of rotating with it.
- All 19 existing ground/wall detail source rectangles hit by real painters.
- Crack-anchor sets grow 61 -> 120 -> 195 -> 259 as escape damage progresses;
  every prior mark keeps its frame. Local rockfall scars are capped at 48.
- Compared 2,359,296 cold/warm floor bytes including chunk-crossing overlays;
  no differences after clipping direct fallback floor painting to chunk bounds.
- Detail toggle changes the cache key; quality 2/3 skips optional decals.
- First-pass synthetic floor/chunk workload measured about 0.8-0.95 ms per
  built chunk on this Windows browser. This is NOT proof of the 0.5ms target
  in broader #112, which remains open. No gameplay tiles/hashes/RNG modified.
- Isolated shadow/fire work: about 0.03 ms/frame over 360 repetitions with
  24 enemies; fixed fire pool 256; State serialized identically before/after.
  CPU-only measurement; canvas/GPU and device performance can vary.
- Native logo is 160x80, 4.60KB, copied unchanged from the owner.
  Enlarged 50% after user feedback: display sizes 240x120 (360x640, 640x360),
  480x240 (1280x800), 720x360 (1920x1080); no tagline overlap or distortion.
- Actual title and playing views inspected. ?ph=1 reaches the world pickup
  stand-ins; default reaches delivered art. No browser exceptions.
- Real main.ts host HMR preserves run/debug choices AND the same live pixel
  pool object with continuing emission. Export debug hidden unless opted in.

#127 follow-up, 2026-10-26 (submitter Kittingsl)
- Golden trail colors: #ffe394, #f9cd60, #d8ab35 at early/mid/late ages.
- Body births: 48 cases (three types, eight directions, idle/moving), sampled
  from opaque dark sprite pixels with a four-pixel inset square. Birth sites
  remain fixed in world coordinates while creatures move or animate.

  match those sites, replacing the previous origin above the fire.
- Shadow radii shrink from 1.0 to 0.2, including death; rising limited to
  4/5/6px over 0.65/0.75/0.9s. Global shadow cap remains 96.
- Required check/build pass. The initial simultaneous build/check run missed
  the AI CPU budget by 0.68ms; the full check passed without concurrent build
  and with a larger Node GC nursery. No threshold changes.
- Browser has no errors; actual-host HMR retains debug choices and live pool.
- Existing pixel-pool checks cover history, pause, reset, quality and teleport;
  added exact origin override and unchanged torch trajectory/lifetime checks.
- Acceptance implemented and verified; visual confirmation still pending.
- Follow-up CPU check: 24 enemies, 360 repetitions, 0.044ms/frame average;
  State unchanged, 256 fire slots, no browser errors (CPU-only measurement).
